environment.description: Kubernetes cluster running tenant-mgmt service in 'tenant-namespace'. The admin-service runs in 'admin-namespace'. No service mesh is deployed. Network policies allow all pod-to-pod communication across namespaces. The JWT_SECRET is set to a known development value. An attacker with a valid 'admin' role JWT can call /api/v1/users/{self}/elevate with target_role=super_admin, and the request reaches admin-service which processes it.
